description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for listing and retrieving HorizontalPodAutoscaler objects in Kubernetes, including namespace-specific listing.

classes.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalerLister
classes.description: Interface for listing HorizontalPodAutoscalers across all namespaces.

classes.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalerNamespaceLister
classes.description: Interface for listing and getting HorizontalPodAutoscalers within a specific namespace.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all HorizontalPodAutoscalers matching a label selector.

methods.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalers
methods.description: Returns a namespace-specific lister for HorizontalPodAutoscalers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific HorizontalPodAutoscaler by name within a namespace.
